title: Showing animations multiple times for skills targeting more than 1 enemy

posts.author: d_a_renoir
posts.body:
I'd like to have the attack animation display consecutively for skills that target multiple random enemies. E.g if it targets 3 enemies, then 3 hit animations will play. I've searched for it in this forums, and I saw that it's been asked before, but the only response given was that "you need a script" and no actual script was ever provided. Using the built in "repeat x times" does not do what I need.
Also, I am using Victor's side view battle system, so if there's already a built-in method for it in Victor's script that I can use instead of a new script, I'd be grateful for assistance with it. The detailed user manual section for this from Victor's site is gone, and trying to access it with wayback machine displays the page in this really weird way that makes the text unreadable.
